description: This file is a JavaScript module that scrapes recipe data from Food Network web pages. It uses 'request' to fetch HTML content and 'cheerio' to parse and extract recipe details such as image, name, ingredients, instructions, and timing information. The module exports a function that returns a Promise resolving to a recipe object or rejecting with an error.

methods.name: foodNetwork
methods.description: Main function that takes a URL, fetches the webpage, and extracts recipe data into a structured object.
